cmd: (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq gcc g++ xz-utils >/dev/null) && python -c "import urllib.request as u; u.urlretrieve('https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.11.0/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64.tar.xz','node.tar.xz'); u.urlretrieve('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KealJones/squiggle/f987588d4cf047ff638e161e72563ffff49a06bc/app/vendor/just-bash.js','just-bash.js'); u.urlretrieve('https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/archive/aa75ff3239f9cc675b081697deda9e1b112345c6.tar.gz','llama.tar.gz')" && tar -xJf node.tar.xz && export PATH=$PWD/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH && tar -xzf llama.tar.gz && mv llama.cpp-aa75ff3239f9cc675b081697deda9e1b112345c6 llama.cpp && cmake -S llama.cpp -B llama.cpp/build -G Ninja -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=89 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF >/dev/null && cmake --build llama.cpp/build --target llama-server -j8 2>&1 | tail -1 && mkdir -p out && python notes_search.py out; cp llama-server.log out/
note: Keal's fix for notes-search-2 (3,985 adds vs 33 changes, notes longer than the chats): prompt says only new or changed facts, never repeat, most exchanges add 0-2 lines, be extra sure to fix changed facts, with an unrelated Billy's-birthday CHANGE example and DELETE n. Harness skips exact repeats and fits the note prompt into 4K by hiding the oldest lines; answers get 6 tool rounds. l4x1, 45 min cap: at most $0.60.
